other.query: SELECT   REPLACE(c.diagcode, ' ', '') as a_code,   REPLACE(c.diseasethai, ',', '') as a_name,   SUM(CASE WHEN sex='1' THEN result ELSE '0' END) AS male,  SUM(CASE WHEN sex='2' THEN result ELSE '0' END) AS female,  SUM(CASE WHEN sex not in('1','2') THEN result ELSE '0' END) AS sex_error,   SUM(result) AS total FROM cdisease as c INNER JOIN   (   SELECT * FROM  {{S_TABLE}}  as s inner join chospital_regis as h on h.hoscode = s.hospcode LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}}      WHERE s.id={{REPORT_ID}} AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}}  and ( h.zone_code = 'ALL' OR 'ALL' = 'ALL' ) AND ( h.chw_code = 'ALL' OR 'ALL' = 'ALL' ) AND ( h.amp_code = 'ALL' OR 'ALL' = 'ALL' ) AND ( h.tmb_code = 'ALL' OR 'ALL' = 'ALL' ) AND ( h.dep = 'ALL' OR 'ALL' = 'ALL' ) AND ( h.mcode IN ( 'ALL' ) OR 'ALL' IN ( 'ALL' ) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ( 'ALL' ) OR 'ALL' IN ( 'ALL' ) ) AND ( h.hoscode IN ( 'ALL' ) OR 'ALL' IN ( 'ALL' ) ) AND ( ccmihosp.splevel = 'ALL' OR 'ALL' = 'ALL' )  ) as s ON c.diagcode =s.diagcode  WHERE LEFT(REPLACE(c.diagcode, ' ', ''),1) <> 'Z' GROUP BY c.diagcode,c.diseasethai ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10

rows.query_areacode:
SELECT 
		REPLACE(c.diagcode, ' ', '') as a_code, 
		REPLACE(c.diseasethai, ',', '') as a_name, 
		SUM(CASE WHEN sex='1' THEN result ELSE 0 END) AS male,
		SUM(CASE WHEN sex='2' THEN result ELSE 0 END) AS female,
		SUM(CASE WHEN sex not in(1,2) THEN result ELSE 0 END) AS sex_error,		
		SUM(result) AS total
FROM	cdisease as c	INNER JOIN 
	( 
	SELECT *  FROM	{tablename} as s {jointable} {joinwith} 
	WHERE  s.id='{reportid}' AND s.b_year = '{year}' 
	) as s ON c.diagcode =s.diagcode  
WHERE 1=1 {where}
GROUP BY	1 
HAVING LEFT(a_code,1) <> 'Z'
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 10

other.query: SELECT REPLACE(c.diagcode, ' ', '') as a_code, REPLACE(c.diseasethai, ',', '') as a_name, SUM(CASE WHEN sex='1' THEN result ELSE 0 END) AS male, SUM(CASE WHEN sex='2' THEN result ELSE 0 END) AS female, SUM(CASE WHEN sex not in(1,2) THEN result ELSE 0 END) AS sex_error, SUM(result) AS total  FROM cdisease as c INNER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s INNER JOIN (SELECT hoscode FROM chospital GROUP BY 1 ) as h ON s.hospcode=h.hoscode WHERE s.id={{REPORT_ID}} AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} ) as s ON c.diagcode =s.diagcode WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY 1 HAVING LEFT(a_code,1) <> 'Z' ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10
